JourneyIQ · Prototype demonstrator

JourneyIQ: an evidence-led operational diagnostic concept.

JourneyIQ remains the working name for the current site. The owner plans to review and change the name in the next version; no broader product or trade-mark claim is made.

Naming status: keep temporarily. JourneyIQ remains visible on the current site; the timing of the next naming decision remains open.

What the concept is

A prototype for structuring a bounded operational question, tracing the available evidence and presenting a reviewable decision brief.

Who it is for

Operations and supply chain leaders who need to clarify a problem before committing to a large programme, system change or pilot.

Inputs

A named decision question, an accountable owner and the minimum approved evidence set. No patient data or confidential files are needed for an initial conversation.

Outputs

A traceable evidence map, visible assumptions, ranked diagnostic questions and a prioritised next-step brief. No automated decision or guaranteed outcome is implied.

Human judgement and AI

AI may assist with approved unstructured material, but accountable human review remains responsible for definitions, calculations, caveats and recommendations.

Before any pilot

  • Next-version naming decision
  • Commercial scope and legal terms
  • Allowed dataset and minimum fields
  • Provider, access and retention controls
  • Named reviewer and success criteria
  • Deletion plan and incident responsibility
